description: Every technology named in a different way than the resume uses it.

expectations.rationale: A per-requirement test of the synonym layer, which is more useful here than a coverage ratio. The job description writes 'Amazon Web Services', 'Postgres', 'RESTful services', 'React.js', 'continuous integration and continuous deployment', 'K8s' and 'Git Hub'; this platform resume writes AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD and Git. So the four synonym pairs the job description puts it at odds with must all match, and the technologies it never mentions - Java, JavaScript, React, PostgreSQL under the name 'Postgres', and REST work - must not. The earlier 0.85 coverage minimum was an expectation about this resume, not about the vocabulary: the job description is a backend, frontend and cloud grab bag and the candidate has no Java, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, React or REST work at all. Corrected in CALIBRATION.md.
